text_block_list.text:
I meet Грасс Вандер at her classroom to
take her
to training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Thank you for coming all this
way.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But may I ask to be excused from
training for
today?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Are you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.text: Well, no. I'm perfectly healthy, it's just—
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Hey, Grass! Can you help me figure
out what
this Classical Japanese poem
means?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Ah! No fair! I was gonna ask her an
English
question!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Just a moment. I'll be right there.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. But you can see how
I'm
needed.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер gives an apologetic bow
before
going back inside the classroom.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
